title: Dizzy or about to faint
whenToUse: You feel lightheaded or dizzy while awake and have no chest pain or stroke signs.

steps.text: Stop what you are doing and lie down right away.
Cross your legs and tense your leg, belly and buttock muscles.
steps.detail: These physical counterpressure manoeuvres help raise blood pressure while you wait for symptoms to pass.

steps.text: Once steady, check your blood pressure using the guided check.

redFlags: Symptoms do not improve within 1 to 2 minutes.
You have chest pain, weakness or trouble speaking.

escalation.text: Red flag or getting worse? Alert a crewmate now. Do not wait for Earth.
